supplemental_examples.title: Supplemental Example — Converting Millilitres to Litres
supplemental_examples.question: Convert 1,750 mL to litres.

steps.explanation: To change millilitres to litres, divide by 1,000.

supplemental_examples.check: Multiplying 1.75 litres by 1,000 gives 1,750 millilitres, the original measurement.

supplemental_examples.title: Supplemental Example — Converting Metres and Centimetres to Centimetres
supplemental_examples.question: A rope is 3 m 45 cm long. Express its length in centimetres.

steps.explanation: Express the complete rope length in centimetres.

supplemental_examples.check: 345 cm consists of 300 cm and 45 cm. Since 300 cm is 3 m, the original length of 3 m 45 cm is recovered.
